requirements.title: Health check endpoint returns status and tool count
requirements.text: GET /api/health returns a JSON response with status "ok" and the number of registered tools.

requirements.title: List tools returns categorized tool catalog
requirements.text: GET /api/tools returns a JSON response with count, categories, and an ordered list of tools with name, category, and description.

requirements.title: Calculator endpoint rejects invalid JSON body
requirements.text: POST /api/calc with malformed JSON body returns 400 with error 'invalid JSON'.

requirements.title: Calculator endpoint sanitizes and bounds numeric inputs
requirements.text: POST /api/calc with a numeric parameter exceeding 1e13 in absolute value returns 400 with an error message.
requirements.quote: raise ValueError(f"'{k}' is out of range")

requirements.title: Calculators enforce DoS-related parameter caps
requirements.text: POST /api/calc with a capped parameter (e.g. years > 120) returns 400 with an error message specifying the max value.

requirements.title: Calculator wraps domain errors into 400 response
requirements.text: POST /api/calc when the calculator function raises ValueError, ZeroDivisionError, KeyError, or TypeError returns 400 with 'invalid inputs: <message>'.

requirements.title: Calculator hides unexpected exceptions from client
requirements.text: POST /api/calc when an unexpected exception occurs returns 400 with 'calculation failed'.

requirements.title: NAV endpoint validates scheme code
requirements.text: GET /api/nav with code parameter that is non-numeric or longer than 9 characters returns 400 with error 'invalid scheme code'.

requirements.title: NAV search query length validated
requirements.text: GET /api/nav with q parameter that is empty or longer than 80 characters returns 400 with error 'query must be 1–80 characters'.
requirements.quote: return JSONResponse({"error": "query must be 1–80 characters"}, status_code=400)

requirements.title: FX rate endpoint rejects invalid currency codes
requirements.text: GET /api/fx with base or symbols not matching the currency code pattern returns 400 with error 'invalid currency code'.

requirements.title: Quote endpoint validates symbol format
requirements.text: GET /api/quote with symbol not matching the symbol pattern returns 400 with error 'invalid symbol'.

requirements.title: API request body size limited
requirements.text: POST /api/* with content-length greater than 16 KB returns 413 with error 'payload too large'.

requirements.title: Security headers added to every HTTP response
requirements.text: Every HTTP response from the server includes security headers: X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy, and Content-Security-Policy.
